# Wardrobes

The Elm two-door wardrobe measures 110 cm wide, 60 cm deep, and 195 cm high. It includes one hanging rail and two adjustable shelves. White, walnut, and light-oak finishes are offered. The unit must be fixed to a suitable wall with the included anti-tip kit.

# Compatibility

Additional Elm shelves are compatible only with the two-door and three-door Elm wardrobes. Assembly requires two adults. Wall construction varies, so customers must select fixings appropriate to their wall.
